question: Do existing GSE135893 donor aggregates retain exact subject/annotation joins and the raw RNA assay needed for a bounded external observational comparison?
decision: Qualify source, assay and cached measurement correspondence before any external effect calculation.
strongest_rival: Processed SCT assay, stale aggregate identities, diagnosis pooling or different annotation may make external comparison invalid.
discriminator: Exact barcode/donor/diagnosis/label matching, duplicate serialization parity, provenance-code hash, current sparse raw assay selected-gene and all-gene-total reaggregation, and RNA-versus-SCT metadata checks.
exposure_record: Primary GSE136831 results are now exposed. GSE135893 prior Ravel aggregate analyses and source metadata are exposed; this is neither held-out confirmation nor a new raw source. Published Habermann separate-collection evidence is recorded by the coordinating review.
biological_unit: Source Sample_Name donor with orig.ident libraries and captured cells nested; exact identities and diagnoses are to be qualified.
nesting_and_overlap: Cells and any repeated libraries nest within source-defined subjects. GSE136831 has already been reused in Ravel; no independent cohort validation is claimed.
population_and_selection: All deposited metadata donors are enumerated; cached IPF/Control subtype units are audited without relabeling other diagnoses. Existing cache has an upstream compartment floor of50cells.
contrast: Assay/identity agreement; no disease expression effect fitted.
endpoint: Exact donor-label counts, selected-gene raw aggregate parity, all-gene denominator parity, clinical/source coverage and annotation comparability.
methods: Read public source metadata and cached integer aggregates, compare NPZ/CSV and preparation totals/code, then stream current raw matrix once for all unit totals and the30prespecified native human symbols.
missingness_and_exclusions: Unannotated matrix barcodes do not enter donor aggregates. Missing symbols, conflicting joins and assay disagreement remain explicit holds.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests or multiple-testing claims.
precision_basis: Metadata census of available files; no population uncertainty or power claim.
interpretation_limit: Published separate collection supports external context, not direct participant identity verification. Different annotations and exposed cached results preclude exact NAM replication or unexposed confirmation.
stop_rule: Stop malformed input, hash, dimension or identity conflicts; preserve failed receipts. Assay mismatches are explicit qualification holds, never repaired by relabeling. No expression effect fitting or restricted analysis.
amendment_reason: Initial separate external-source qualification; primary human results and previous external aggregate work are exposed.
